runbook.title: Kitchen runbook
runbook.intro: Lantern Lane Community Kitchen: who we deal with and the numbers we use.

procedures.title: the bread order
procedures.intro: Can you send tomorrow's bread order to Sandgate Bakery? {n} large loaves. Their orders address is {value}.
short: Send {alias} tomorrow's bread order: {n} large loaves.
Bread order to {alias} for tomorrow please - {n} large loaves.
Can you do tomorrow's bread order with {alias}? {n} large loaves.

procedures.title: the extra bin collection
procedures.intro: Can you book {n} extra bin collections this week with the council's trade waste team? Email them at {value}.
short: Book {n} extra bin collections with {alias} for this week.
We need {n} extra bin pickups this week - can you book them with {alias}?

procedures.title: the weekly newsletter update
procedures.fact: the Food Drive Network's newsletter address
procedures.intro: Send this week's kitchen update to the Food Drive Network newsletter at {value}: we served {n} meals.
short: Send this week's kitchen update to {alias} newsletter: we served {n} meals.
Newsletter update for {alias} please - {n} meals served this week.

procedures.title: the weekly veg order
procedures.intro: Can you send the weekly veg order? {n} kg of potatoes. Our veg supplier is {name} - orders go to {value}.
short: Do the weekly veg order: {n} kg of potatoes.
Veg order time - {n} kg of potatoes please, send it to {alias}.
Weekly veg order: {n} kg of potatoes.

procedures.title: the dry-goods order
procedures.intro: Please send the dry-goods order: {n} kg of rice. We buy dry goods from {name} - orders to {value}.
short: Dry-goods order please: {n} kg of rice.
Can you order {n} kg of rice from {alias}?

procedures.title: the cleaning-supplies order
procedures.intro: Order {n} boxes of gloves for the kitchen, please. Cleaning supplies come from {name} ({value}).
short: Order {n} boxes of gloves from {alias}.
We're low on gloves - order {n} boxes please.

procedures.title: the food-bank session
procedures.intro: Put the food bank session on {date} in the kitchen calendar - it runs {value}.
short: Put the food bank session on {date} in the kitchen calendar.
Add {date}'s food bank session to the calendar please.

procedures.title: the kitchen deep clean
procedures.intro: Book the kitchen deep clean for {date} in the calendar. The cleaners come {value}.
short: Book the kitchen deep clean for {date} in the calendar.
Deep clean on {date} - put it in the calendar.

procedures.title: a volunteer induction
procedures.intro: {who} is starting with us - add their volunteer induction on {date} to the calendar. Inductions run {value}.
short: {who} is starting - add their volunteer induction on {date} to the calendar.
Can you put {who}'s induction in the calendar for {date}?

procedures.title: the petty-cash float request
procedures.intro: Email finance ({to}) the petty-cash float request for the week of {date}. The float is {value}.
short: Send finance the petty-cash float request for the week of {date}.
Can you ask finance for this week's float? Week of {date}.

procedures.title: the van fuel request
procedures.intro: Ask finance ({to}) for the van's fuel allowance for the week of {date} - it's {value} a week.
short: Ask finance for the van's fuel allowance for the week of {date}.
Fuel allowance request for the van please, week of {date}.

procedures.title: the donations summary
procedures.intro: Send the treasurer this week's donations summary: GBP {n} in total. Our treasurer is {name} ({value}).
short: Send the treasurer this week's donations summary: GBP {n} in total.
Donations summary to the treasurer please - GBP {n} this week.

procedures.title: the maintenance summary
procedures.intro: Send the building manager the weekly maintenance summary: {n} tickets still open. That's {name} ({value}).
short: Send the building manager the weekly maintenance summary: {n} tickets still open.
Maintenance summary to the building manager - {n} open tickets.

procedures.title: the rota reminder
procedures.intro: Send the volunteers ({to}) this week's rota reminder, with the swap rule: swaps need {value}' notice.
short: Send the volunteers this week's rota reminder, with the swap-notice rule.
Rota reminder to the volunteers please - remind them how much notice a swap needs.
procedures.doc_rule: at least {n} hours before the shift

procedures.title: the fridge-log reminder
procedures.intro: Send the volunteers ({to}) the weekly fridge-log reminder: fridges must be at {value} or below.
short: Send the volunteers the weekly fridge-log reminder with the fridge temperature limit.
Fridge-log reminder to the volunteers please, with the temperature limit.

procedures.title: the shift-limit reminder
procedures.fact: the weekly shift limit per volunteer
procedures.intro: Email the volunteers ({to}) the weekly reminder that each person may do at most {value} a week.
short: Email the volunteers the weekly reminder about how many shifts each person may do.
Send the volunteers the shift-limit reminder for this week.
procedures.doc_rule: At most {n} shifts per volunteer per week

preferences.fact: how Mara wants weekly summaries laid out
preferences.say_change: Actually, I'd rather have weekly summaries as {value} from now on.

preferences.fact: which tea Mara likes at trustee meetings
preferences.say_first: For the record, I drink {value} tea at the trustee meetings.
preferences.say_change: I've gone off peppermint - it's {value} tea for me at trustee meetings now.

misstated.fact: the date of the van's MOT
misstated.say: The van's MOT is booked for {wrong}.
misstated.fix: Sorry, I misread the letter - the MOT is {right}, not {wrong}.

misstated.fact: the date of the food hygiene inspection
misstated.say: The food hygiene inspector is coming on {wrong}.
misstated.fix: Correction: the inspection is on {right}. I had the wrong week day.
